focus.name: game-startup-stack-slot
focus.purpose: Close the apparent high-frequency DAT_00FFEFD4 RAM identity after confirming it is stack bookkeeping rather than persistent gameplay state.

evidence: All 42 exported writes to 0x00FFEFD4 originate from BSR/JSR return-address sites in Game_InitializeAndEnterFrameLoop.
The sole exported read at 0x001A8BA4 is the MOVEM restore after a nested call, so the address is also reused as a saved-register stack location.
No independent data/function reader or writer exists in the whole-ROM database.
conclusion: DAT_00FFEFD4 is a Ghidra stack-analysis artifact at the startup stack window, not a canonical gameplay RAM variable.
